subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a targeted `/models test-fallback` command, fold this behavior into `models status --probe --all`, or defer it to staged model-migration UX?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in current source, but the requested command creates live provider-call UX and overlaps two open model-safety feature requests, so maintainers need to choose the permanent command surface before implementation.

options.title: Add targeted fallback-chain probe
options.body: Implement `/models test-fallback` as a narrow diagnostic that starts from configured fallbacks and reports first or all fallback results.

options.title: Fold into model health checks
options.body: Make the broader `models status --probe --all` work the canonical place for fallback health validation.

options.title: Defer to staged migration UX
options.body: Handle fallback testing only inside a larger model migration, promotion, and rollback workflow.

recommendation.title: Add targeted fallback-chain probe
recommendation.body: Implement `/models test-fallback` as a narrow diagnostic that starts from configured fallbacks and reports first or all fallback results.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from status-probe history, fallback-resolution history, and the prior detailed issue review.
